description: Kitani trains this model on every conversation sent to it, and you are paid for each completed reply. You earn $0.135 per million input tokens and $2.25 per million output tokens, added to your balance after about a day; using it costs nothing. Spam or abusive requests earn nothing. Don't send private information or other people's personal data. Not available with zero-data-retention settings or Private Mode. Text and up to four images in, tool calling, optional reasoning, 200,000-token context and up to 8,192 output tokens.
name: evolve-beta
